body:
PR156's saved RMP43 snapshot has a small wrong-sign multiplier and a canonical strong-duality gap above 1e-8. This change separates optimal-dual identity from a mathematically valid conservative lower-bound certificate, then measures one bounded early B&P experiment. The certificate passes; the experiment produces no global gap improvement, so early B&P is not selected and no 7200s grant or P2 solve is launched.

### Dual authority

- Fix `TAU_DUAL=1e-8`. Canonicalize one wrong-sign Pi of `4.7607799183594876e-11` to exact zero; reject larger wrong-sign violations. Never individually zero RC.
- Recompute all 83,058 RC/bound terms. Exact rational CSR/CSC checks agree, all 1,841 retained-column constraints pass, and all 81,216 true-free coordinates have exact zero RC after the equality proof. Numerical free-RC maximum before rational repair: `1.466129041787695e-11`.
- Preserve strong-duality difference `1.7415433958910485e-8` and `OPTIMAL_DUAL_IDENTITY=false`. Weak duality, rational support and the same-dual corrected-bound proof pass: `CONSERVATIVE_DUAL_LB_CERTIFICATE=true`, `EXACT_DUAL_AUTHORITY_FOR_BAP=true`.
- Restricted RMP safe LB `0.5729385880789613` is not a global M1 LB. Canonical full-domain corrected LB is valid but loose (`-4.916856034238022`); effective global floor remains certified inherited `0.5687115725336208`.

### Bounded experiment

The PR145 framework gains opt-in original-space branching before pricing closure. Retained columns and full-domain unseen pricing obey identical branch decisions. Restricted LP objectives, restricted integer-master bounds, and restricted infeasibility never become global proof claims; incomplete leaves remain open. Physical constraints, pricing domain, genuine negative RC, exhaustive branching and global gap target `.005` remain unchanged.

A same-pool 1,841-column integer master supplies independently verified original-feasible UB `0.6694159238756877`. Preparation uses two native calls: initial 120s-cap attempt without an incumbent, then a registered 480s-cap fresh search completing in 283.398s. Total preparation native time is 403.415s, separate from the benchmark. Restricted optimality is not full-domain M1 optimality.

| 600s experiment metric | Result |
|---|---:|
| Global UB, start/end | 0.6694159238756877 |
| Certified global LB, start/end | 0.5687115725336208 |
| Global gap, start/end | 15.043614552672% |
| Generated nodes / open leaves | 11 / 6 |
| Pricing / RMP calls | 16 / 5 |
| New validated columns | 16 |
| Native runtime | 499.698s |
| Actual wall, including publication | 600.246686s |
| Gap reduction per wall second | 0 |
| Peak process RSS / commit | 3.250 / 4.384 GiB |

The 600s deadline requests native termination; last native call exits at 600.022559s and receipt publication takes 0.224127s. No new native call begins after the deadline and no budget extension occurs. RAM/commit telemetry is read-only; there is no resource-based throttling or guard.

`EARLY_BAP_SELECTED=false`: more nodes and columns alone do not meet the practical selection condition. Historical root continuation retained the same certified floor; this is not a paired fresh runtime comparison or general speed claim. P1 remains unaccepted because 15.0436% exceeds .5%; P2 and 7200s development are not run. Root CG continuation calls are zero.

### Validation and provenance

- 81 regression tests pass. Five new unpriced-root fixtures agree with direct MILP and complete trajectory integer masters; original PR145 framework fixtures also pass.
- Independent closeout makes zero native optimization calls and audits four raw node snapshots, exact same-dual corrected bounds, all native pricing candidates, original integer/physical feasibility, and binary child union/disjointness.
- Preserve all 974 PR155 files, 30 prior reproduction artifacts and 38 prior numerical-audit artifacts byte for byte. Manifest covers 100 artifacts and 11 source-file hashes.
- Benchmark source is frozen at `b7c48b95746d1c25cb7a09dab6180f23d7100a11`. Subsequent explicit unchanged primal gates and invalid-native-point bound rejection are independently verified against every recorded case; full-scale experiment is not repeated.
- Branch from actual PR156 head `feb19bf42552c2bf2fbec173c754c7ead50c3219`, preserving requested `18561c476ec7b22e496700395d617515b317e656` ancestor and later evidence.

Evidence and Korean closeout: `docs/v42_m1_conservative_early_bap_20261006/FINAL_REVIEW_KO.md`, `FINAL_RESULT.json`, `SHA256_MANIFEST.json`, raw snapshots and native/node/pricing ledgers.
title: V42 M1: certify conservative dual bounds and benchmark early B&P
